title: 🍏 New Leak: "iPhone 18e" Gets a Square Camera Bump.. and the Only One with This Design!
body: 🍏 New Leak: "iPhone 18e" Gets a Square Camera Bump.. and the Only One with This Design!

Computer-design images seen by tech reports revealed that the awaited "iPhone 18e" will get an entirely new camera bump, resembling the bump on "Pro" phones, in a change that brings the budget version closer to its pricier siblings.

The images show an almost square bump measuring about 28 mm by 35 mm, containing the single rear camera, an "LED" flash, and the rear microphone, a design close to the camera unit of the new tablet, while the current "iPhone 17e" has no bump at all, just a lens slightly raised from the rear glass.

What is striking is that the "iPhone 18e" will be the only phone with this new bump, as the same files show that the regular "iPhone 18" will keep its same design with a slightly thicker camera unit, from 3.45 mm to 3.8 mm, which may mean new sensors, even though the company has used the same 48-megapixel sensor in its basic phones since the "iPhone 15".

As for the "iPhone Air 2", the images confirm it will get a second rear camera, an ultra-wide lens, after its absence was among the most prominent complaints about the first generation, while keeping its 5.6 mm thickness, and the three phones retain the same "Dynamic Island" opening instead of the smaller opening in the "Pro" phones.

The source of the images is a party familiar with "Apple's" supply chain that previously provided accurate information about the colors of the "iPhone 17" and "iPhone 18 Pro" before their announcement, and the three phones are expected to launch in spring 2027, with a note that these changes may be canceled before launch.
Simply put: the cheapest upcoming iPhone will look like a "Pro" from the back.. with a square bump and a single camera.. so does the shape of the camera bump matter to you when buying a phone?
Do you prefer that the budget phone gets the design of "Pro" phones?
